title: Agreement and disagreement probabilities
statement: Let $-1\le\rho\le1$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. For a correlated pair $(X,Y)$ formed by choosing $X$ uniformly from the sign cube and, independently in each coordinate, keeping $X_i$ as $Y_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and otherwise flipping its sign, the probability that $f(X)=f(Y)$ equals one minus the probability that $f(X)\ne f(Y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
